title: WOS Studio (Authoring) — EmbeddingProfile + EvidencePacket
description: Versioned embedding profile catalog plus retrieval-router evidence-packet shape per studio/specs/retrieval-router.md. EmbeddingProfile pins (modelId × modelVersion × profileKind × sourceObjectKind × chunkingStrategy) with explicit invalidation events; RetrievalIndex implementations honor `invalidatedBy` filters at query time. EvidencePacket is the shape returned by the router's stage-6 assembly: hits with their source-standing labels and TrustZone tags, plus the automation-eligibility floor that downstream consumers (AI extraction, policy studio) check before driving automation.
$comment: Promotion status (Stage-8 enhancement E2, 2026-05-08): MVP shape. Per-profile chunking-strategy parameters are intentionally permissive (additionalProperties: true on `chunkingStrategy`) so model-family-specific tuning lives outside the spec.

x-lm.intent: Document type marker for the Studio EmbeddingProfile + EvidencePacket schema family

$wosStudioEmbeddingProfile.description: Document marker pinning this artifact to the Studio EmbeddingProfile 1.0 schema.

EmbeddingProfile.description: Per SA-MUST-router-020/021/022. Pins the embedding's identity (model + version + chunking + sourceObjectKind) and tracks invalidation. Two profiles with identical (modelId, modelVersion, profileKind, sourceObjectKind, chunkingStrategy) are duplicates; the registry adapter MUST reject duplicates per SA-MUST-router-022.

profileKind.description: Per SA-MUST-router-020. Enum is closed; new kinds require additive schema extension.

x-lm.intent: Embedding profile kind — load-bearing for router stage-3 routing

chunkingStrategy.description: Profile-specific chunking parameters (token windows, overlap, structural-boundary rules). Permissive on inner shape; the (modelId, modelVersion, profileKind, sourceObjectKind, chunkingStrategy-tuple) identity is what counts for invalidation.

sourceObjectKind.description: What kind of Studio object this profile embeds. Per SA-MUST-router-021.

invalidatedBy.description: AuthoringProvenanceRecord id whose eventKind is `embeddingInvalidatedByModelChange` or `embeddingInvalidatedBySupersession`. When set, RetrievalIndex MUST exclude embeddings of this profile from query results (per SA-MUST-router-024). Reviewers MAY query historical profiles directly for audit but MUST NOT use them in automation paths.

trustZone.description: Computed TrustZone of the profile's source objects. For sourceObjectKind=SourceFragment: derived from SourceVersion lifecycle. For sourceObjectKind=PolicyObject / NormativeStatement: derived from PolicyObject lifecycle. The value is informational on the profile; per-hit TrustZone tags are emitted by the router (EvidencePacket).

then.$comment: Per SA-MUST-router-023: an invalidated profile MUST also carry invalidatedAt for audit-trail completeness.

EvidencePacket.description: Router stage-6 output per SA-MUST-router-040..042. Carries the ranked hits, the trust-zone floor that gated this query, and the automation-eligibility computed across the packet. Consumers (AI extraction, policy studio) check `automationEligible` before driving automation; semantic-only retrieval MUST NOT drive automation regardless of hit scores (SA-MUST-router-041).

queryRef.description: Reference to the query (free-form id; the registry adapter logs the full query for replay).

trustZoneFloor.description: Minimum TrustZone admitted into this packet. Stage-1 hard filter rejects below the floor. Per SA-MUST-router-040.

automationEligible.description: Computed across the packet: TRUE only if (a) trustZoneFloor >= Z5 AND (b) every hit's source has SourceAuthority.automationEligibility = canDriveAutomation AND (c) at least one stage-2 (lexical) or stage-4 (structured rerank) signal contributed (semantic-only retrieval is FALSE per SA-MUST-router-041).

stagesContributed.description: Which router stages produced signals for this packet. Used by SA-MUST-router-041 to enforce automation-eligibility composition.

hits.description: Ranked retrieval hits. Order is router-determined.

rejected.description: Hits filtered out at stage 1, retained for audit when the router records full provenance. Optional.

EvidenceHit.description: A single retrieval hit. Carries source-standing label and TrustZone tag for downstream filtering. Per SA-MUST-router-042 every hit MUST carry both trustZone and authorityClass.

sourceFragmentRef.description: Id of the SourceFragment / PolicyObject / NormativeStatement the hit refers to.

profileId.description: EmbeddingProfile.profileId that produced the semantic-stage signal for this hit (omitted when the hit was lexical-only).

authorityClass.description: Resolved SourceAuthority.authorityClass for the hit's source. References the 12-value enum from wos-studio-source-authority.schema.json.

stages.description: Per-hit list of router stages that contributed signal. Aggregates into EvidencePacket.stagesContributed.
